Linda (Sales): Heads up — Silverpine asked for an exec touchpoint this week. CTO wants a short call but they're hung up on legal/QA items. Need CTO availability + confirmation on POC environment and pricing for a 6-week pilot. Any updates?

Omar (Solutions Eng): POC infra ready in our sandbox. Can stand up a Private trial VPC if they need BYO-KMS. Need their CIDR + SAML metadata for SSO. Can demo model latency at ~50 req/s.

Cleo (Eng): Quick runbook snippet to share with ops:```
# temporarily allow Silverpine IPs
iptables -A INPUT -s 34.56.78.90 -j ACCEPT
# generate staging token
redwoodctl tokens create --env staging --expiry 7d
```We also need their IP list for allowlist and a service account for KMS testing.

Sarah (Legal): Please send the draft contract redline to legal@redwood.ai. If they're insisting on data flow diagrams, ask them to fill the standard security questionnaire (https://redwood.ai/security-qa). We can turn around the SOW redline within 48h if there are no material changes.

Raj (Product): Pricing note — for a 6-week pilot we can offer a limited pilot discount but need expected QPS and token volume. If they want Dedicated capacity we need commitment numbers. Also, Dedicated + BYO-KMS has an additional ops surcharge.

Linda (Sales): Silverpine's initial ask: CTO sync tomorrow at 11am ET, pilot: 6 weeks, expected 100k tokens/day, may want SSO + BYO-KMS. Can the eng/legal/product folks make 11am ET? @Omar @Cleo @Sarah @Raj

Omar (Solutions Eng): I can do 11am ET. I'll prepare perf slides and a short demo (5-7m).

Cleo (Eng): 11am ET works. I'll bring the runbook and confirm network/allowlist steps. I'll also prepare a short checklist for on-prem test keys.

Sarah (Legal): I can join briefly but if it's exec-level CTO conversation I'd prefer to sync after with Silverpine in-house counsel. I'll prioritize the redline once they send it.

Raj (Product): I can cover pricing for Dedicated vs Hosted at 11am. Quick ask: Linda, can you get them to confirm QPS and whether they'd need multi-region?

Linda (Sales): I'll get QPS + SSO vs basic auth clarity before the call. Action items:
- Linda: confirm QPS and SSO/KMS requirements
- Omar: perf demo + slides
- Cleo: network/runbook + staging token
- Sarah: legal intake link + availability for redline
- Raj: pricing options + brief cost calc
I'll set a 11am ET bridge and send calendar invite in 10m :calendar: 

deploy-bot: Meeting invite created by Linda — "Silverpine CTO sync" tomorrow 11:00 ET. Join link: https://zoom.redwood.ai/j/123456789

Linda (Sales): Thanks team. If we get the SSO metadata before noon today we can pre-provision users and save time. Ping me direct if anything blocks.
